ABOUT THE PRODUCT

Sponge Sheets.

Felt-laminated sponge sheets are semi-finished products in which a sponge body and scouring felt are laminated together into sheets.

The sheets are supplied for cutting to the required size in the production of dish sponges and similar products. Felt colour, sponge colour and thickness are agreed together according to your needs.

  • Sponge + scouring felt lamination
  • Suitable for cutting to size
  • Colour and thickness options
